title: Exclusion Tree / 排除树
subtitle: Dense bilingual troubleshooting path used to verify wrapping, branch spacing, and canvas expansion.

problem.text_en: Intermittent Startup Failure After Overnight Storage
problem.text_zh: 隔夜存储后间歇性启动失败

event_detail.title: Event Detail
event_detail.text: The unit intermittently fails during startup after overnight storage, then recovers after a full power cycle.
bullets: Observed in validation and engineering debug
Use this path to eliminate common causes first
Escalate only after all checks pass

checks.text_en: External power source and input connector remain stable during startup?
checks.text_zh: 外部电源和输入连接器在启动期间是否稳定？

fail_conclusion.detail_en: Check adapter, cable bend, connector retention, and contact resistance.

checks.text_en: Power module output reaches nominal voltage before controller boot?
checks.text_zh: 控制器启动前电源模块输出是否达到标称电压？

fail_conclusion.detail_en: Measure ramp time and load transient at low temperature.

checks.text_en: Control board clock and reset signals are present and sequenced correctly?
checks.text_zh: 控制板时钟和复位信号是否存在且时序正确？

fail_conclusion.text_zh: 控制器复位或时钟故障

checks.text_en: Startup command signal is detected by the controller input pin?
checks.text_zh: 控制器输入脚是否检测到启动命令信号？

checks.text_en: Chamber temperature profile and soak duration match the validation procedure?
checks.text_zh: 温箱曲线和保温时间是否符合验证流程？

checks.text_en: Operator setup record confirms the correct fixture and released test instruction?
checks.text_zh: 操作记录是否确认使用正确夹具和发布版测试指导？

fail_conclusion.detail_en: Review fixture revision, work instruction, and setup photo evidence.

final_pass_conclusion.text_en: No issue found in this path. Escalate to rare component-level causes or deeper waveform capture.
final_pass_conclusion.text_zh: 该路径未发现异常。升级检查少见器件级原因或进行更深入波形捕获。
